package.name: tf2_standalone
package.description:
Standalone wrapper around tf2::BufferCore with a ROS-agnostic API.
This library provides coordinate transform capabilities without requiring ROS headers or libraries at runtime. The public API uses only: - tf2::Transform, tf2::Quaternion, tf2::Vector3 (LinearMath types from tf2) - tf2::TimePoint, tf2::Duration (std::chrono based, from tf2/time.hpp) - std::string for frame IDs
At build time, copies tf2's LinearMath headers, time.hpp, exceptions.hpp, and visibility_control.h. Builds as a static library (for standalone .deb packaging) or as a shared library (for colcon/ament workspace builds).
Note: this package uses ament as its build system but is not intended for installation into a ROS environment. The shared library build exists to avoid breaking colcon workspaces that include this package.
